# Jensen Huang

## Basic Information
- Type: person
- Source: [_id-401_current_version](../sources/_id-401_current_version.qmd)

## Description
Jensen Huang is the CEO of [Nvidia](nvidia.qmd) and a prominent industry voice advocating for the rapid scaling of Generative AI. He is widely recognized for championing an industry narrative centered on the optimization of AI infrastructure, often referred to as the "electrons-to-tokens" model. This framework is frequently critiqued in research literature for its ecologically linear and extractive approach to technological growth. Huang’s influence on the semiconductor industry remains a critical subject of study in the transition toward more sustainable technological development.
